Chunk up datasets ready to send to FR geoserver

Chunking the datasets will allow the app to be run in shiny.io

```{r}

bng <- "27700"

library(raster)
library(sf)
library(terra)


ew10k <- st_read("C:/Users/ik929086/OneDrive - University of Southampton/R_data_transfer/Deer impact EW risk maps/10k_tiles_EW_Scotland_border_buffer.shp")

#Read in chunked datasets

#small deer impact risk tiles
small_deer_risk_tile_dir <- "C:/Users/ik929086/OneDrive - University of Southampton/R_data_transfer/Deer impact EW risk maps/wood_poly_risk_extraction_by_tile_small_deer_V3"

rds_small_risk_tiled_files <-list.files(small_deer_risk_tile_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
small_deer_tile_list <- lapply(rds_small_risk_tiled_files, readRDS)

# Extract tile_IDs from each list of RDS files
small_tile_ids <- sapply(small_deer_tile_list, function(x) unique(x$tile_ID))

#large deer impact risk tiles
large_deer_risk_tile_dir <- "C:/Users/ik929086/OneDrive - University of Southampton/R_data_transfer/Deer impact EW risk maps/wood_poly_risk_extraction_by_tile_large_deer_V3"

rds_large_risk_tiled_files <-list.files(large_deer_risk_tile_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

#lcm polys chunked into tiles
tile_dir = "C:/Users/ik929086/OneDrive - University of Southampton/R_data_transfer/Deer impact EW risk maps/split_polys_by_tile_lcm_polys"

#These are all done, now just need to chunk up the rasters


```

```{r Get tiles for chunking datasets}

# Get list of RDS files
rds_tiled_poly_files <- list.files(tile_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
# Read in tiles
tiles_list <- lapply(rds_tiled_poly_files, readRDS)
#name tiles with tile_id
names(tiles_list) <- sapply(tiles_list, function(x) unique(x$tile_ID))
#name tiles with tile_id
# filter ew10k for matching tile_name
selected_tiles <- ew10k[ew10k$tile_name %in% names(tiles_list), ]
missing_tiles <- ew10k[!ew10k$tile_name %in% names(tiles_list), ]

```

```{r}

#Function to split polygon datasets:
source("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/code/functions/split_wood_polys_by_tile.R")

#Function to split raster:
source("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/code/functions/split_raster_by_tile.R")

#Focal DAMS extraction at 1000m
Focal1000_DAMS <- terra::rast("~/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023/large_deer/focal_DAMS_1000m.tif")
crs(Focal1000_DAMS) <- "EPSG:27700"
dams_tiles_dir <- "C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/focal1000_dams_10km_chunked"
dams_tiles_chunked <- split_raster_by_tile(raster_data = Focal1000_DAMS,
                                           tiles = selected_tiles,
                                           file_prefix = "focal1000_dams_tile_",
                                           output_dir =  "C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/focal1000_dams_10km_chunked")

dams_tiled_files <- list.files(dams_tiles_dir, pattern ="\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

#Raw NFI dataset
nfi <- st_read("~/iDeer/data/raw-data/nfi-2023-raw/National_Forest_Inventory_GB_2023.shp")

nfi_output_dir <- "C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/nfi_chunked_10km"
nfi_per_tile <- split_wood_polys_by_tile(wood_polys = nfi,
                                  tiles = selected_tiles,
                                  output_dir = nfi_output_dir)

nfi_tiled_files <- rds_small_risk_tiled_files <-list.files(nfi_output_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
nfi_files <- lapply(nfi_tiled_files, readRDS)

# Extract tile_IDs from each list of RDS files
nfi_tile_ids <- sapply(nfi_files, function(x) unique(x$tile_ID))


#Merged NFI polys
GB_polys_unmerged <- readRDS("C:/Users/ik929086/OneDrive - University of Southampton/R_data_transfer/Deer impact EW risk maps/NFI_2023_all_woods_UK_touching_groups.rds")
GB_polys_unmerged <- st_as_sf(GB_polys_unmerged)
GB_merged_output_dir <- "C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_nfi_polys_merged_chunked_10km"

GB_merged_polys_per_tile <- split_wood_polys_by_tile(wood_polys = GB_polys_unmerged,
                                  tiles = selected_tiles,
                                  output_dir = GB_merged_output_dir)

GB_merged_poly_files <- list.files(GB_merged_output_dir,pattern ="\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

#which tiles are missing?
nfi_small_diff <- setdiff(small_tile_ids,nfi_tile_ids)

# The missing tile IDs
#These tiles don't contain NFI woodlands
missing_tiles <- c("SN36", "SS75", "SW81", "SX14", "SY38", "TR33")

# Add a column to flag missing tiles
ew10k$missing <- ifelse(ew10k$tile_name %in% missing_tiles, "Missing", "Present")

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = ew10k, aes(fill = missing), color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Present" = "white", "Missing" = "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "EW 10k Tiles — Missing vs Present",
       fill = "Tile Status")


```
